originality.rationale: The structural bijection from Wall forms to direct reflection factorizations is explicitly prior art (McCammond–Paolini) and not claimed new. The arithmetic result separately evaluates all square-class-resolved prescribed-target fibers for finite orthogonal groups and all target multiplicities and exact two-step total variation for O3. The inspected primary sources supply class sizes, moved-space structure and line incidence schemes but not this evaluated combined group class-algebra distribution. An accessible earlier claim on 2x2 determinant-minus-one GL2 involutions concerns the SL2 convolution, which does not cover either mixed spinor reflection classes or every PGL2 target. Residual risk: an unstated classical PGL2 character-table coefficient or reformulated line-scheme intersection number might duplicate the numerical formulas.
residual_risks: Finite PGL2 class-algebra character tables may encode the exact two-reflection structure constants with different notation; an equivalent old table cannot be excluded.
Odd-field conic-line association scheme intersection parameters might have a nonobvious reduction to these fiber counts.
Wall factorization correspondence is definitely prior art; originality claim is only for the explicit arithmetic evaluation, full ternary spectrum and exact two-step mixing.
Semantic retrieval and accessible published comparisons do not establish mathematical uniqueness.
